d: The Data Center Manager is entrusted with the overall management, governance, and operational excellence of a 24/7 mission-critical data center facility. You will provide strategic leadership, ensuring the maximum availability, reliability, and efficiency of all data center operations, meeting both customer and business requirements. As part of our team in Kuwait, you'll work in an ONSITE environment and be accountable for delivering operational continuity, managing risk, maintaining facility reliability, optimizing resources, and driving continuous improvement. This position oversees the complete infrastructure lifecycle, maintains regulatory, security, and safety compliance, aligns with Tier certifications and ISO frameworks, and ensures positive customer and stakeholder experiences.
q: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
Minimum 10 years' experience in data center operations or critical facility management.
Proven experience with mission-critical infrastructure, large-scale MEP operations, and 24/7 site management.
Demonstrated leadership of operational teams, incident management, and service delivery.
Experience in vendor and contractor management.
Strong knowledge of operational governance frameworks (SOPs, MOPs/EOPs, documentation, and standardization across sites).
Expertise in data center critical infrastructure systems (electrical UPS, generators, switchgears, power distribution, mechanical chiller/cooling, pumps).
Familiarity with operational and audit practices in compliance with ISO, Uptime Institute and industry standards.
Experience in capacity, asset and maintenance management including RCM, preventive, and corrective maintenance strategies.
Proficient with monitoring systems (BMS, EPMS, DCIM, fire detection, access control, alarm management).
Strong understanding of KPI definition, incident analysis, and operational reporting.
Solid background in HSE practices including permit to work, LOTO, contractor safety, and critical environment safety.
Professional certifications such as PMP, ITIL, or Uptime Institute certification.
Master's degree in a relevant discipline.
Experience in the UAE or GCC region's industrial or data center zones.
Working knowledge of project management methodologies, Lean, or Six Sigma practices.
